definitions.gloss: Eiken, the STEP English proficiency test
definitions.explanation: Short for {実用英語技能検定|じつようえいごぎのうけんてい}, the English test run since 1963 by the Eiken Foundation of Japan and taken by many junior and senior high school students. Its grades run from 5{級|きゅう} (easiest) to 1{級|きゅう} (hardest), with {準|じゅん} (pre-) grades in between.

{英検|えいけん}2{級|きゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。

⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧{在学中|ざいがくちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{英検|えいけん}{準|じゅん}1{級|きゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}れば→取る：00565_toru⟧、⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有利|ゆうり}→有利：03651_yuuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Getting Eiken Grade Pre-1 while still in high school can give you an advantage in university entrance exams.
